spindle.observe.RequestClass.title: RequestClass
spindle.observe.RequestClass.description: How a served run answered one request; the class follows who answered, not the status. `served`: the model answered it, with an outcome the command declares or the view's rows, whatever status the binding gives that outcome, `501` and `503` included. `refused`: the ingress or ESS's standard refusal answered it `4xx` before the model did, other than `not-granted`. `not-granted`: `403` "not granted", no grant admits the actor. `not-served`: spindle's own `501`, for an operation this ingress cannot route, the kernel does not run or the host does not read, or for an external cause nothing answered. `failed`: a `5xx` spindle itself answered, other than that `501`. `unrouted`: no route has the path, or not under that method.
